account_id.description: The account most of the supplier's bill lines cost: its contact's default when it has one, else the most used.

from_bills.description: How many of the supplier's bills the suggestion rests on; 0 when only the contact's own defaults are shown.

gst_code.description: The GST code most of its lines use: its contact's default when it has one, else the most used.

saved_on_contact.description: true when the contact already holds these as its defaults.
